exposure: PKA phosphorylation of Cx43 at serine 369 and 373
Mutant Cx43 with phosphoserine-mimicking amino acid substitutions
outcome: Gap junction assembly at the plasmalemma
cohort: The study participants were human trophoblast cells.
finding: PKA phosphorylates serine 369 and 373 on connexin 43, which enhances gap junction assembly, communication, and cell fusion, thereby promoting trophoblast differentiation.
